captain_law: DO NOT ADD A WITNESS-SPECIFIC TERMINAL. PRICE THE TEMPORARY ASCENT AND REQUIRE NET DESCENT AT THE MACRO BOUNDARY.

applicability.precondition: ordinary frozen R33 reduction, declared terminals, affine recognition, R35B RUP and immediate-descent SA-BVE expose no committed move

for_each_variable_with_both_polarities: compute the complete non-tautological Davis-Putnam resolvent set for x
delete only clauses independently shown subsumed by another retained clause
apply the already-frozen R33 exact reduction stack
check already-declared semantic terminals and frozen affine terminal
if still nonterminal, apply frozen R35B single-literal RUP to fixpoint with independent replay
candidate_generation.selection: Among candidates that end in an independently verified semantic terminal or strict CLV decrease relative to S, choose semantic terminal first; otherwise lexicographically smallest output CLV; tie-break by smallest eliminated variable id.

polynomial_intermediate_envelope.intermediate_clause_count_upper_bound: C + C^2/4 before subsumption, hence O(C^2)
required_implementation_ledger: RUP checks, propagation scans and literal inspections
peak intermediate clauses, literals and bytes
polynomial_intermediate_envelope.warning: These syntactic envelopes establish only that the proposed one-level macro can be implemented with polynomially bounded local work under standard explicit representations; they do not prove universal applicability or the full TRUMP L4 bound.

exactness_contract.DP_elimination: independent checker recomputes every polarity pair and every non-tautological resolvent
exactness_contract.subsumption: every omitted clause/resolvent must have a retained subsuming clause
exactness_contract.R33: existing transition certificates and reconstruction trace
exactness_contract.SAT_after_elimination: reconstruct every eliminated variable in reverse and replay the final model against the original pre-macro CNF
exactness_contract.UNSAT_after_elimination: equisatisfiability of exact DP elimination plus independently replayed terminal refutation transfers UNSAT back to the pre-macro CNF

coverage_obligation.statement: FOR_ALL reachable nonsemantic stalls S of the successor controller: EXISTS x such that EXACT_DP_NORMALIZE_NET_DESCENT_MACRO_v1(S,x) returns a verified semantic terminal or strict net CLV descent
